newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chu Kong says HK public offer 480 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Chu Kong says HK public offer 480 times subscribed.

text.p: Chu Kong Shipping Development Co Ltd said on Tuesday that its initial public offering of shares in Hong Kong was approximately 480 times subscribed.
The shipping and transportation concern offered a total 187.5 million shares at HK$1.20 per share in an IPO, out of which 18.75 million shares were offered to employees.
The public portion was approximately 480 times subscribed, the company said in a statement.
Dealings in the shares on the stock exchange of Hong Kong will commence on Friday, May 23, it said.
